findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_doshas, get_longevity · Private data: get_arudha_padas, get_dasha, get_divisional_chart · Public sink: get_dasha, get_divisional_chart, get_planet_ingress.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_doshas, get_longevity · Private data: get_arudha_padas, get_dasha, get_divisional_chart · Public sink: get_dasha, get_divisional_chart, get_planet_ingress

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
